'''''Samol''''' was a group of nine [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]] operated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

Shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], they attacked the [[SpecWar Fab]] [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] and were thwarted by an Imperial [[Missile Boat]].
